comment: Free-LLM provider rotation for the task worker. Two gates, both fail-closed. (1) Human approval: a provider may only run agentic work when tier is 'approved'. (2) Numeric floor: the score must still meet min_agentic_coding_score, set to MiniMax-M3's corrected 63.6 (the stated quality bar). The score is now percentile-normalized per benchmark and requires real agentic evidence, so a model with only LiveCodeBench results has no agentic score at all instead of an inflated one. Providers marked 'utility' are fine for short non-agentic jobs (titles, summaries) and are never selected for issue implementation.

quality_policy.note: Scores are percentiles within each benchmark, weighted toward SWE-rebench. A model needs >=2 components and at least one of SWE-rebench / SWE-bench Verified / LiveBench-agentic to receive an agentic score; the arena-only figure lives in avg_agentic_coding_score_arena_only and never satisfies this floor on its own.

providers.note: Rejected by the owner for agentic coding: old and unreliable on multi-step work. Under the corrected scoring it has no agentic score at all (LiveCodeBench-only). Allowed only for short utility tasks in a different context.

Leads the arena coding board (1560 ELO), but no agentic evaluation exists for it: swebench.com has not accepted a run since Feb 2026 and swe-rebench has not evaluated it. Candidate for approval once an agentic benchmark covers it.
Key expired 2026-10-01 after CI overuse; disabled by the provider owner.
